categories.main_business_segments: Suntar Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: membrane technology applications and water investment operations. The membrane technology segment includes industrial liquid separation, membrane water treatment, environmental engineering, membrane spare parts, and household water purification devices. The water investment segment focuses on municipal sewage treatment plant investment and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops advanced inorganic non-metallic membrane materials and high-performance composite membranes, including nanofiltration cores, ceramic membranes, hollow fiber membranes, MBR membranes, spiral membranes, and graphene membranes. It integrates membrane materials, components, equipment, software, and applications to provide comprehensive membrane solutions. Production involves in-house manufacturing of membrane materials and assembly of membrane components and equipment, with some standardized parts outsourced under strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical, chemical, food and beverage, biopharmaceutical, metallurgy, petrochemical, salt lake lithium extraction, water purification, and environmental protection industries. The company serves manufacturing enterprises, municipal management departments, and end consumers for household water purification. Major markets include industrial liquid separation, product purification, wastewater resource recovery, and drinking water safety assurance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive domestic coverage, including multiple municipal sewage treatment projects across various provinces. It also has overseas operations centered in Singapore, with sales and technical offices in Southeast Asian countries such as Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand. Overseas business is expanding, especially in membrane water treatment markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suntar operates across the full membrane industry chain, from upstream membrane material development and production, through midstream membrane component and equipment manufacturing, to downstream membrane system integration and application services. It also engages in water investment and municipal sewage treatment operations, positioning itself both as a technology provider and an operator in the water treatment value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation with a strategic focus on developing new membrane materials, improving membrane performance, and expanding membrane application fields. R&D priorities include nanofiltration, ceramic membranes, graphene membranes, membrane software, and integrated membrane systems. It invests in advanced research platforms and collaborates with universities and research institutes to enhance innovation capabilities and maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of membrane materials, membrane components, membrane equipment, and integrated membrane systems, along with related technical services and spare parts. The water investment segment earns income from municipal sewage treatment service fees under EPC, BOT, BT, and TOT contractual models. The company also sells household water purification devices and net water equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Suntar is a leading domestic and internationally recognized membrane technology company in China. It is among the earliest to industrialize advanced membrane applications in pharmaceutical and industrial liquid separation fields. The company holds a strong market position with proprietary core technologies and a comprehensive membrane industry chain, competing with multinational membrane technology firms and domestic peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, a slight decrease of 4.11% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 23.97% to about RMB 315 million. Total assets reached over RMB 6.12 billion, growing 10.53% from the previous year. The company maintains steady growth with increasing profitability and expanding operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suntar offers unique value through its advanced membrane materials with proprietary technology, including high-performance ceramic and graphene membranes that outperform imported alternatives. Its integrated membrane solutions and customized membrane software enable efficient, clean production and water treatment processes. The company’s comprehensive industry chain coverage and strong R&D capabilities provide customers with high-quality, innovative, and cost-effective membrane separation and water treatment solutions.
